directions: In the following text, some sentences have been removed. Choose the most suitable one from the list A–E to fit into each of the numbered blanks. There are two extra choices, which do not fit in any of the blanks. Mark your answers on the ANSWER SHEET 1. (10 points)

materials.title: Part B · 7选5 原文
materials.section: Section II · 新题型 Part B

blocks.text: Habit formation is often described as a matter of willpower, yet the evidence points elsewhere. __41__ When the sight of running shoes by the door becomes part of the morning scenery, the decision to exercise has already been half made.
Environment beats motivation over the long run. __42__ A reader who keeps a book on the pillow reads more pages a year than one who relies on evening enthusiasm.
None of this happens overnight. __43__ The point is not to design a perfect system on the first day, but to let a modest one survive its first boring week.

questions.section: Section II · 新题型 Part B
questions.stem: 第 41 空：从下列句子中选出填入本空的选项

options.text: Design your surroundings so that the good choice is also the convenient one.
Researchers who track daily routines find that context, not character, decides most repeated actions.
The same principle explains why few people succeed by keeping a rigid hourly schedule.
Small, repeated cues gradually turn an intention into an automatic habit.
Critics argue that such methods reduce rich lives to checklists.

questions.explanation: P1 先否定意志力，再引出环境线索使行动自动化的观点，D 承接语义。
